main_claim: Daniil Donchenko beat Punahele Soriano by unanimous decision (30-27, 30-27, 29-28) on the UFC Paris main card.
note: A card-wide live blog: the quick-results list has 'Daniil Donchenko def. Punahele Soriano by unanimous decision' and the play-by-play gives his bout three rounds of its own ('Donchenko lands a combo of short punches that drops Soriano!'), so his part is a new account of his fight, not a recap, hence one_of_several; but he is one of fourteen bouts treated alike and the guide lists 'results page' under only_mentioned, so a careful editor could pick that.
